gate: Verify the complete all30 cause barrier before actual material reads; keep all15 selections sealed before the first alarm role is dispatched.
scope: Adds deterministic original document selection and derivation provenance to ALARM-POLICY-v1; it changes no source, requirement, cause unit, threshold, original grade or result.
public: Final versions include every own original public request from D0 through original self-seal, each original submission and all selected reports. I includes both original own-source D0 repeats. No filtering by P/F/U/status.
private: Include registered original and effective private native attempts and any licensed failed entry for the same version, retaining absence/error availability. They are labeled independent_private_after_seal, never worker detection.
reports: Use the exact REPORT_NAMES constant in the pinned material.py across every original immutable service inventory. Keep every original member/array in each selected report, except reviewed safe outer identity/execution omissions. Include raw native observation with issues and all original PNGs for each distinct capture; exact image aliases may be referenced with SHA proof.
outcomes: A fixed fact projection retains all original OUTCOME_FIELDS, including error and positive acceptance claims. Every remaining outcome key must belong to the explicit execution/provenance OUTCOME_METADATA schema; unknown fields stop preparation. Original raw outcome pins and exact selected/omitted field names stay in the separate derivation ledger.
source: Retain exact supporting source-version bytes. Recover a source member only from an original own initial/final capsule with the exact required SHA and bytes; any missing intermediate source remains unavailable. Source-version identities use the original controller full-capsule content SHA, distinct from selected-platform SUT native hashes.
identity: The separately reviewed v2 projection engine alone changes exact machine-path or tool-name metadata. Protected UI/actual/expected subtrees are immutable. Generated neutral intermediates carry raw-original refs and transformation proofs in the operator derivation ledger; preparation does not replace raw evidence or adjudicate alarms.
failures: Unfamiliar schemas, identity-bearing facts or missing pins fail closed with original attempts retained. Any generic presentation correction is versioned and applied uniformly before any alarm role sees material. No incomplete packet is dispatched.
